title: Building – Electromagnetic Locking Devices and Impeded Egress Zone December 2013
description: A health-care provider built a sprinklered, two-storey combustible supportive-living building, divided by 2 h firewalls, with a secure dementia (SL-4D) area. It installed electromagnetic locks that would not release 15 seconds after pressure was applied.

refusal.basis: analogous: appeal of an s.49 order issued after a Request for Specific Variance. The panel found both insufficient evidence and non-equivalence (form reason 3 also supported).

outcome_summary: Compliance with ABC 2006 3.4.6.15.(4)(e) was still required, but the deadline changed from 11 Oct 2013 to 'prior to building occupancy'.
